verdict.line: You lose if you stand in Kled's 800-range hook before level 2; you win if you burst Skaarl's bar down and finish him dismounted.

brief.thesis: Kled's whole kit is built around Skaarl soaking damage for him while his Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) outranges every engage tool Riven has before level 2. The matchup is decided by whether Riven can force the dismount — bursting Skaarl's health bar down faster than Kled can poke her down with Q and E — because once he's dismounted he deals less damage to champions and loses his hook entirely. The 49.1% win rate over 53 games confirms this is close, but the lane and solo-kill edge both sit with Kled, so uncontested fights favor him and forced ones favor you.

theirWindow.when: Kled's Q (Bear Trap) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can hook you from 800 range and yank you in for bonus damage once shackled. Don't stand still at his max range; close distance or use E (Valor) to step through his throw angle so the trap whiffs.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl's bar breaks and he dismounts
yourWindow.what: Kled deals less damage to champions while dismounted and his Q is temporarily replaced by the knockback-only Pocket Pistol. Chain Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) immediately and hold Ignite to close it out before he refills courage and remounts.

start.why: 96.7% pick rate for a reason — the extra HP and sustain let you eat Q pokes and empowered Violent Tendencies autos without losing the trade war before you have W (Ki Burst) online.

boots.why: 53.8% win rate over Plated Steelcaps here. Ability haste shortens Q/W/E cooldowns so you can re-threaten the dismount window more often instead of just tanking his poke.

core.why: 57.1% win rate in this path — cooldown reduction on R (Blade of the Exile) means you can reset into a second Skaarl-burst window inside the same extended fight.
Sustain and burn damage to keep whittling Skaarl's bar between trades, since he regains courage by fighting and you need chip damage that doesn't fall off.
Heals back a portion of the damage he lands with Q and his empowered W autos, letting you stay in range to finish the dismount burst instead of backing off.

runes.keystoneWhy: This fight has two health bars to break through (Skaarl, then Kled), so the sustained-damage-into-healing scaling of Conqueror rewards staying in extended trades rather than one burst and disengage.

summoners.why: 93.6% pick rate here. Ignite is what actually converts a forced dismount into a kill instead of just a won trade, and Flash lets you dodge the Q yank or close the gap when his hook is down.

playing.title: Don't contest before level 2
playing.detail: Before W (Ki Burst) comes online, Kled's 800-range Q outreaches both your Q (275 range) and E (250 range). Farm through his poke rather than trying to trade.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's bar, not his HP
playing.detail: His health splits into a mount bar and his own. Only once the Skaarl bar hits zero does he dismount and start dealing reduced damage to champions — that's your kill signal, not his total HP.

playing.title: Dodge the hook, don't facetank it
playing.detail: Bear Trap on a Rope yanks you toward him with bonus damage once shackled. Use E (Valor)'s forward step to clear his throw angle or close distance before he can land it off its 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Jousting
playing.detail: If his E (Jousting) dash passes you without the return cast, he has no gap-close or escape for 13-9s. Immediately chain Q (Broken Wings) into W (Ki Burst) for a free stun combo.

playing.title: Time E (Valor) into Violent Tendencies
playing.detail: His W gives four empowered attacks with the fourth hitting hardest. Valor's damage block during the forward step is strongest if you eat that fourth swing rather than the first.

playing.title: Burst, don't poke, to break Skaarl
playing.detail: Skaarl absorbs damage from any source, so trading in autos alone is slow. Land full Q-W combos (and R when up) to drop the mount bar in one burst rather than chip damage over several autos.

playing.title: Hold Ignite for the dismount, not the poke
playing.detail: Spending Ignite early just resets his courage faster through forced fighting. Save it for the moment Skaarl's bar breaks so the follow-up combo actually kills him before he remounts.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the win rates, pick rates, and matchup shape are OP.GG's numbers. The mechanical reasoning — why the dismount window matters, how to dodge the hook, when to punish Jousting — is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: It is important to avoid Kled’s (Q) skill. Deal burst damage multiple times to force Kled to dismount, and go for the kill.
